name: promo-story
title: Promo story
description: Full-screen “what’s new” story for dialog records with presentation: story. Pass it to PromoDialog as story={PromoStory}. It only opens when the visitor asks.
docs: Requires Base UI 1.8+ (a base-* shadcn project) for the Dialog. Render it through the free dialog: <PromoDialog story={PromoStory} />.
